mapper.sql: SELECT t.id, t.tree_code, t.species, t.variety, t.area, t.location, t.longitude, t.latitude, t.tree_age, t.plant_time, t.height, t.crown_diameter, t.health_status, t.client_id, c.client_name, t.dept_id, d.dept_name, t.image_url, t.remark, t.create_time, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM trim_record r WHERE r.tree_id = t.id) AS trim_count, (SELECT MAX(r.actual_trim_time) FROM trim_record r WHERE r.tree_id = t.id) AS last_trim_time FROM tree t LEFT JOIN sys_client c ON t.client_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON t.dept_id = d.id
mapper.select: SELECT id, tree_code, species, variety, area, location, longitude, latitude, tree_age, plant_time, height, crown_diameter, health_status, client_id, dept_id, image_url, remark, create_time, update_time FROM tree WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tree (tree_code, species, variety, area, location, longitude, latitude, tree_age, plant_time, height, crown_diameter, health_status, client_id, dept_id, image_url, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{treeCode}, #{species}, #{variety}, #{area}, #{location}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{treeAge}, #{plantTime}, #{height}, #{crownDiameter}, #{healthStatus}, #{clientId}, #{deptId}, #{imageUrl}, #{remark}, SYSDATETIME())
mapper.select: SELECT t.area AS area, COUNT(1) AS tree_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.id IS NOT NULL THEN t.id END) AS trimmed_count FROM tree t LEFT JOIN trim_record r ON r.tree_id = t.id GROUP BY t.area ORDER BY tree_count DESC
SELECT species AS species, COUNT(1) AS [count] FROM tree GROUP BY species ORDER BY [count] DESC
